{{Vanilla|Flint and Steel}}
{{Infobox auto}}
A '''fire starter''' is a tool used to light fires, [[Kindling|kindling]], candles, TNT and nether portals. It is the vanilla {{MCW|Flint and Steel|flint and steel}}, renamed and made from two pieces of flint instead of flint and an iron ingot, so it can be made before the player has any metal.

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
Two flint make a fire starter.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/fire_starter.json}}</ref> The vanilla recipe is removed.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/pack.mcmeta}}</ref> Picking up flint unlocks the recipe.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/recipe_unlocks/flint.json}}</ref>

=== Chest loot ===
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==
The fire starter works exactly like vanilla flint and steel.

== Trivia ==
* The pack contains two identical fire starter recipes, <code>fire_starter</code> and <code>flint_and_steel</code>; only the first is unlocked in the recipe book.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/flint_and_steel.json}}</ref>
* The item texture shows two pieces of flint rather than a steel striker.
